title: Quality Attributes Catalog
description: Schema for the catalog of quality attributes of GIS software applications in the energy sector. The catalog is the reference model of the testing approach; a malformed catalog must fail CI.

$schema.description: Relative pointer to this schema, for editor tooling.

catalogVersion.description: Semantic version of the catalog. Bump it whenever an attribute, test, or expected evidence changes, so evidence bundles remain traceable to the catalog revision that produced them.

attributes.description: The quality attributes. The approach defines exactly 13; the count is fixed here so that an accidental deletion or duplication fails validation.

id.description: Stable machine identifier. Gates and analyzer output reference attributes by this id, so it must never change once published.

name.description: Human-readable name as it appears in the paper. Kept in English.

description.description: What the attribute means for a GIS application in the energy sector.

tests.description: The tests required to exercise this attribute. The generative analysis stage may only recommend tests drawn from this list.

expectedEvidence.description: The evidence expected for the attribute to be considered satisfied.

supportingStudies.description: Identifiers of the primary studies that support this attribute in the systematic review.

criticality.description: Relative importance of the attribute for this system, on a 1-5 scale. Null until the team assigns it; the pipeline must not infer it.
